### MasterBrand Announces CFO Transition


October 26, 2026


*Mark Young, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, Named VP and Interim CFO*


BEACHWOOD, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC, the “Company,” or “MasterBrand”), the largest residential cabinet manufacturer in North America, today announced the appointment of Mark Young, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, as Vice President and Interim Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. He succeeds Andrea Simon, who has agreed to remain with the Company in an advisory capacity through March 31, 2027, to facilitate a seamless transition. The Company has initiated a comprehensive search process, with the assistance of a leading executive search firm, to identify a permanent CFO from internal and external candidates. Ms. Simon’s departure is not related to any issues with respect to the integrity of the Company’s financial statements or accounting policies and practices.


“On behalf of the Board and management team, I'd like to thank Andi for her many contributions to MasterBrand over the past six years,” said Dave Banyard, MasterBrand’s President and Chief Executive Officer. “Her leadership helped establish MasterBrand as a standalone public company, and now is the right time to make this transition. We wish her all the best.”


Mr. Young has served as MasterBrand’s Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer since joining the Company in 2022. In this role he has been responsible for financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy. He has more than 20 years of finance and accounting leadership experience across the manufacturing industry and public accounting. Prior to joining MasterBrand, Mr. Young held accounting leadership roles at Cooper Tire & Rubber Company, where he led the global accounting function and SEC reporting.


Mr. Banyard continued, “Mark’s deep knowledge of our strategic priorities and financial operations makes him well positioned to serve as interim CFO at this important point in our integration journey following the merger with American Woodmark. Mark’s understanding of both businesses and prior integration experience will be instrumental in advancing the work underway. The Board and I have full confidence in his ability to lead the finance organization while we conduct a search for a permanent CFO.”


**About MasterBrand**


MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC) is the largest manufacturer of residential cabinets in North America and offers a comprehensive portfolio of leading residential cabinetry products for the kitchen, bathroom and other parts of the home. Delivered through our exceptional distribution network, MasterBrand products are available in a wide variety of designs, finishes and styles and span the most attractive categories of the cabinets market: stock, semi-custom and premium cabinetry. Additional information can be found at[www.masterbrand.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.masterbrand.com&esheet=54628256&newsitemid=20261026213708&lan=en-US&anchor=www.masterbrand.com&index=1&md5=ce367e15be75684160c54057dfb1580b) .
